block.occultism.ritual_catcher.auto_tool:
Collects the results of nearby completed rituals. Creates a Flame of Automation if no output item is present or if it has already been collected.
Working Area: 21x9x21
block.occultism.ritual_catcher_dark.auto:

effect.occultism.aquatic_lord.descriptio: Makes aquatic creatures friendly toward you.
effect.occultism.double_jump.description: Allows you to perform extra jumps in mid-air.
effect.occultism.dragon_greed.descriptio: Increases the amount of experience dropped.
effect.occultism.fairy_bless.description: Converts part of your damage into magic damage and increases the effectiveness of healing received.
effect.occultism.forest_whisperer.descri: Makes illager, arthropod and creeper friendly toward you.
effect.occultism.greedy_harvest.descript: Blocks that can be mined with a pickaxe are broken at a fixed speed.
effect.occultism.herald_aberrations.desc: Makes warden, enderman, shulker and vex friendly toward you.
effect.occultism.nether_emperor.descript: Makes undead and nether creatures friendly toward you.
effect.occultism.pumpkin_head.descriptio: Endermen won't become hostile when you look them in the eyes.
effect.occultism.step_blocked.descriptio: Sneaking prevents you from falling off blocks, even with increased step height.
effect.occultism.step_height.description: Each level slightly increases step height.
effect.occultism.third_eye.description: Allows you to see and interact with basic materials from the Otherworld.
gui.occultism.tablet.familiar.status.too: Enable or disable the familiar ability.
item.occultism.familiar_glove.auto_toolt: Can hold up to six familiars.
item.occultism.flaming_paste.auto_toolti:
Can be eaten, granting Strength and Fire Resistance.
Can be used as a fuel, burns one item per durability point.
Right-click a mob or hit it to set it on fire.
Right-Click on a block acts like a Flint and Steel.
Shift-Right-Click on a block acts like a Lava Bucket.
item.occultism.infused_axe.auto_tooltip: Allows you to COLLECT covered otherworld trees without the third eye effect.
item.occultism.ritual_dummy.craft_flamin: An Afrit will craft the flaming paste mixing ingredients.
item.occultism.ritual_dummy.craft_infuse: Infuse an Axe to store familiars that can mine otherworld logs and applies their effects to the wearer.
The Infused Boots can store familiars and applies their effects to the wearer.
The Infused Chestplate can store familiars and applies their effects to the wearer.
The Infused Helmet can store familiars and applies their effects to the wearer.
Infuse a Hoe to store familiars that can mine otherworld plants and applies their effects to the wearer.
The Infused Leggings can store familiars and applies their effects to the wearer.
Infuse a Shovel that can store familiars to mine otherworld terrain and applies their effects to the wearer.
Infuse a Spear to store familiars and applies their effects to the wearer.
Infuse a Sword to store familiars and applies their effects to the wearer.
item.occultism.ritual_dummy.craft_wormho: The Wormhole Tablet is a personal teleportation device. It can store up to 9 compasses and teleport the user to their bound locations.
item.occultism.ritual_dummy.misc_familia: Eldritch Spirits will forge a familiar glove that can store up to six familiars and apply their effects to the wearer.
item.occultism.ritual_dummy.misc_infused: Wild Spirits will forge a Infused Horse Armor.
Wild Spirits will forge a Infused Nautilus Armor.
item.occultism.ritual_dummy.resurrect_ca: Ritual: Raise Camel as Camel Husk
Raise a Camel as Camel Husk through corrupted resurrection.
item.occultism.ritual_dummy.resurrect_sk: Ritual: Raise Horse as Skeleton Horse
Raise a Horse as Skeleton Horse through corrupted resurrection.
item.occultism.ritual_dummy.resurrect_zo: Ritual: Raise Horse as Zombie Horse
Raise a Horse as Zombie Horse through corrupted resurrection.
Ritual: Raise Nautilus as Zombie Nautilus
Raise a Nautilus as Zombie Nautilus through corrupted resurrection.
item.occultism.wormhole_tablet.auto_tool:
Right-click to teleport.
Shift-right-click to open its inventory.
Shift-scroll to change the selected location.
jei.occultism.ingredient.spawn_egg.famil: The Wingnis Familiar can be obtained by bringing a Drikwing Familiar to any Nether Biome and clicking the bird with a Totem of Undying, then Flaming Paste. Before Drikwing dies in the fire, the totem will be used and will activate the Flaming Paste that covered it, transforming it into a Wingnis. See §6Dictionary§r §6of§r §6Spirits§r for more information.
